resolutions.researcher_notes: Both sources (Ministry of Energy press release, 2025-09-06) state: 'на горном участке магистрального газопровода Ахангаран — Пунган ... подключен дополнительный газопровод протяженностью почти 22 км, а также завершены монтажные работы' / 'ввод в эксплуатацию нового газопровода' = 'on the mountain section of the Akhangaran-Pungan trunk gas pipeline ... an additional pipeline about 22 km long has been connected and installation work completed' / 'putting the new pipeline into operation' -- directly confirms this segment ('Expansion'/looping) was commissioned and in service as of 2025-09-06. As of today (2026-08-26), nearly a year on with no report of shutdown, Status=operating is well supported. NOTE: spot.uz and uzdaily.uz both republish the SAME Ministry of Energy release verbatim (one origin, two outlets) -- treated as ONE source, not two independent ones, hence medium not high tier; a third outlet (podrobno.uz) carrying the same release was checked and adds nothing further. Old current_ref (Facebook video URL + liting.uz) both confirmed dead: liting.uz is a JS-rendered app shell (raw HTML/Wayback capture both return no readable article text, consistent with the prior deep-sweep audit's finding), and the Facebook video URL is unreachable/blocked from this session. Searched in Russian; no independent Uzbek-language coverage of the 2025 commissioning found this session.

kun.uz (2020-09-08, EDC/Epsilon press release on the 2020-08-15 construction start) states: '...магистрального газопровода «Ахангаран - Пунган», протяжённостью 25 км, который обеспечит бесперебойные поставки природного газа...' = '...the Akhangaran-Pungan trunk GAS pipeline, 25 km long, which will provide uninterrupted NATURAL GAS supply...' -- direct support for Fuel=Gas. spot.uz (2025-09-06, independent Ministry of Energy release on commissioning) again explicitly calls it '...магистрального газопровода Ахангаран — Пунган, снабжающего природным газом потребителей...' = '...the Akhangaran-Pungan trunk gas pipeline, supplying natural gas to consumers...'. Two editorially independent origins (private engineering-firm press release, 2020, vs government ministry release, 2025) both name this exact segment as a natural-gas pipeline -- high tier. Old current_ref (utg.uz/ru/invest/investitsionnye-proekty/) confirmed dead (404); its Wayback capture (2026-04-19) could not be content-verified this session (empty/failed fetch, consistent with the intermittent archive.org content-serving issue noted 2026-08-26). Searched in Russian.

Same two sources as Fuel [ref]. Both explicitly use 'магистральный газопровод' (trunk/MAIN gas pipeline) for this exact segment -- direct support for PipelineType=transmission. kun.uz (2020, construction start) and spot.uz (2025, commissioning) are independent origins five years apart describing different milestones of the same project -- high tier. Old current_ref (utg.uz) confirmed dead; see Fuel [ref] note. Searched in Russian.

kun.uz (2020-09-08 press item) states '15 августа [2020 г.] начато строительство лупинга на высокогорном участке магистрального газопровода «Ахангаран - Пунган»' = 'on 15 August [2020] construction began on the looping of the high-mountain section of the Akhangaran-Pungan trunk gas pipeline' -- directly supports ConstructionYear=2020. lex.uz (Presidential Decree PP-4563, item 12: 'Строительство лупинга к магистральному газопроводу «Ахангаран-Пунган», Ташкентская и Наманганская области, 2020 — 2022, ... АО «Узтрансгаз»') independently corroborates a 2020 authorized start for this exact line item, an editorially independent government-primary source. Two independent origins -> high tier. NOTE (data-entry defect, not a sourcing gap): the sheet's ConstructionMonth cell currently holds a raw ref-URL string ('https://kun.uz/ru/08357022#!') instead of a month -- apparently a ref pasted into the value column. The correct month per this same source is August. This shard supports the ref_col's primary_value (ConstructionYear=2020); recommend Update also correct ConstructionMonth to 'August'. Searched in Russian.

Old current_ref (liting.uz/?p=933) confirmed dead: the live page and its 2026-04-21 Wayback capture both return no readable article content (a JS app shell) -- fetch of the capture returned an empty body this session. The RECORDED value StartYear1=2020 disagrees with what was found and is NOT supported: every 2020-dated source (kun.uz, uzreport.news -- both the same EDC/Epsilon press release verbatim) describes CONSTRUCTION START on 2020-08-15, not entry into service. Independently, the Ministry of Energy's 2025-09-06 release (spot.uz, uzdaily.uz, one origin republished twice) states the additional ~22 km section on this exact segment was connected and put into service ('ввод в эксплуатацию') that day, and the PP-4563 decree's own target completion window for this line item is 2020-2022 -- neither points to 2020 as an operational start year. Per standing rule (support the recorded value, never a different one), this is routed UNRESOLVED rather than confirmed. Flagging for Update: evidence points to StartYear1=2025 / StartMonth1=September, consistent with the prior deep-sweep audit's independent status-review finding. Searched in Russian.

Delayed=yes itself is corroborated (see below), but the recorded DelayType='inferred' disagrees with what was found: PP-4563 (lex.uz) sets a 2020-2022 target completion window for this exact looping item, and the Ministry of Energy's own 2025-09-06 release (spot.uz/uzdaily.uz) documents the additional section actually being connected/commissioned on that date -- roughly three years past the decreed target, i.e. a DOCUMENTED slip, not one inferred from silence/dormancy. Per standing rule (support the recorded value, never a different one), routed UNRESOLVED rather than confirming 'inferred' -- flagging for Update to consider DelayType='confirmed'. Searched in Russian.

Two figures for this same segment conflict. kun.uz/uzreport.news (2020-09-08, verbatim-identical EDC/Epsilon press release -- ONE origin, not independent of each other) state 'протяжённостью 25 км' = 'length of 25 km', which matches the sheet's recorded LengthKnown=25.00 exactly. But the Ministry of Energy's 2025-09-06 completion report (spot.uz/uzdaily.uz/podrobno.uz, another single origin) states 'дополнительный газопровод протяженностью почти 22 км' = 'an additional pipeline about 22 km long' was what was actually connected. This is most likely a planned-route (2020, 25 km) vs. as-built (2025, ~22 km) discrepancy over the 5-year build, but it cannot be resolved to confirm the recorded 25.00 km figure with confidence from sources read this session. Per standing rule (support the recorded value, never a different one -- and a genuine conflict is not support), routed UNRESOLVED; flagging for Update to reconcile which figure the sheet should carry. Searched in Russian.

StartLocation=Ahangaran/StartState=Tashkent/StartCountry=Uzbekistan and EndLocation=Pungan/EndCountry=Uzbekistan are consistent with sources read, but the recorded EndState/Province='Fergana' disagrees with what was found and is NOT supported. PP-4563 (lex.uz), item 12, scopes this exact looping project to 'Ташкентская и Наманганская области' = 'Tashkent and NAMANGAN oblasts' -- Fergana region is not named. A 2024 gazeta.uz article on regional road infrastructure independently places the settlement Pungan/Pop district in Namangan region, not Fergana. Per standing rule (support the recorded value, never a different one), routed UNRESOLVED rather than confirmed; flagging for Update to consider EndState/Province='Namangan' (consistent with the prior deep-sweep audit's independent finding, which raised the identical concern). Searched in Russian.
